hooks.command: msg=$(jq -r '.message // empty' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]'); case "$msg" in *"waiting for your input"*) ;; *) [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && tmux set-option -w -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_working '❓' ;; esac; true

soft_deny: Bash(terraform apply:*) in infra/terraform — Protected-Scope IaC Apply given prod.env/prod.secrets.env config present
environment: **Cloud provider(s)**: AWS (aws CLI used in-project 9× and in shell history 143×; internal hosts and bucket names are AWS-flavored)
**Repository visibility**: assume private (Bitbucket remote for gohealth-engineering; not queryable via gh since origin is not github.com)
**Internal sharing / snippet hosting**: None configured — treat public paste/gist services as outside the trust boundary
**Default / protected branches**: main (default branch; protection status not queryable — origin is not github.com)
**Source control**: Bitbucket repo gohealth-engineering/conversational-intelligence-platform (origin) only — no additional orgs configured
**Trusted cloud buckets**: gh-cip-uat-gohealth-7512d900 (config-derived — not a confirmed upload destination; uploads of local data still require confirmation)

**Sensitive data locations & audiences**: .env and runtime-configuration secrets files (apps/aqa-dashboard, apps/cip-core, apps/cip-call-data-parser, apps/cip-call-insights, apps/cip-local-sqs-worker — prod.env, prod.secrets.env, qa.secrets.env, uat.secrets.env), apps/cip-core/migrations/0026_increase_encrypted_data_longblob.sql (encrypted data schema); share only with audiences cleared at the [named+specifics] bar

**Sensitive remote targets**: any namespace, host, or container whose name carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment; also apps/*/runtime-configuration/prod.env, prod.secrets.env, and apps/aqa-dashboard/scripts/start-as-prod.sh

**Protected deployment namespaces / environments**: None configured — fall back to the Sensitive remote targets heuristic (note: k8s namespaces migrate-llm-qa-qa-to-uat and migrate-qa-to-uat seen in use are QA/UAT migration namespaces, not prod)

**Protected IaC scopes**: IAM, RBAC, networking, quota, and node-pool resources; anything whose name or tag carries prod or production as a whole word or name segment (infra/terraform present in repo)
**Primary use of Claude Code**: software development (Conversational Intelligence Platform monorepo — Node/TypeScript services, Terraform infra)
